title: Advanced Technology
description: A High-Tech Modpack focused on nuclear power, automation, and energy systems.
body:
# Advanced Technology

Advanced Technology is a High-Tech modpack for Minecraft 1.12.2 focused on nuclear engineering, automation, and energy systems.

This modpack is centered around HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod (CE Edition), combined with Mekanism, the Thermal Series, Draconic Evolution, and advanced automation tools.

Players progress from basic industrial machines to large-scale nuclear reactors and late-game energy systems capable of producing massive amounts of power.

## Core Features

- Nuclear technology and reactor systems
- Industrial automation and ore processing
- Advanced power generation and storage
- End-game energy engineering
- Large-scale factory progression

## Recommended Settings

- Minecraft 1.12.2
- Forge 14.23.5.2864
- 10GB – 12GB RAM allocation

## Warning

Nuclear systems can be dangerous if misconfigured. Backups are recommended.
